subtitle_zh: 这里是克朗代克淘金热国家历史公园游客中心。
subtitle_en: This is the Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park Visitor Center.

subtitle_zh: 通过展览、文物和历史资料，它讲述了一百多年前那场改变阿拉斯加和育空命运的淘金热。
subtitle_en: Through exhibits and artifacts, it tells the Gold Rush story of Alaska and Yukon.

subtitle_zh: 如果时间充裕，非常值得停下来，了解这段精彩的历史。
subtitle_en: If you have time, it is worth stopping here to learn this history.

subtitle_zh: 穿过市中心，一座古朴的教堂静静地坐落在树林前。
subtitle_en: Walking through downtown, an old church sits quietly before the trees.

subtitle_zh: 它已有一百多年的历史，见证了史凯威从淘金热时代一路走到今天。
subtitle_en: It has over a century of history, witnessing Skagway from the Gold Rush to today.

subtitle_zh: 与热闹的商业街相比，这里显得格外宁静。
subtitle_en: Compared with the busy shopping street, this place feels especially peaceful.

subtitle_zh: 继续往前走，我们看到几位身穿十九世纪服装的演员，在楼上的窗户向游客挥手。
subtitle_en: Farther along, performers in 19th-century costumes wave to visitors from upstairs windows.

subtitle_zh: 她们扮演的是淘金热时期酒馆和娱乐场所里的女性角色。
subtitle_en: They play women from the saloons and entertainment halls of the Gold Rush era.

subtitle_zh: 轻松幽默的互动表演，让市中心仿佛回到了那个热闹非凡的淘金年代。
subtitle_en: Their playful performance makes downtown feel like it has returned to the Gold Rush days.

subtitle_zh: 演员们不仅服装十分考究，连举手投足都充满那个年代的味道。
subtitle_en: Their costumes are detailed, and even their gestures feel true to that era.

subtitle_zh: 她们热情地和游客互动，也成为史凯威街头一道独特而有趣的风景。
subtitle_en: Their warm interaction with visitors becomes a unique and fun street scene.

subtitle_zh: 这样的现场表演，让历史不再只是博物馆里的展品，而是真正活了起来。
subtitle_en: This live performance makes history feel alive, not just something inside a museum.
